Updates `postcss` from 8.5.15 to 8.5.23
Release notes

Sourced from postcss's releases.

8.5.23

  • Do not load source map without opts.from for security reasons.

8.5.22

  • Fixed custom property losing semicolon before a comment (by @​sarathfrancis90).

8.5.21

  • Fixed childless at-rule losing semicolon before comment (by @​sarathfrancis90).
  • Fixed docs (by @​isker).

8.5.20

  • Fixed missing space if AtRule#params is set after (by @​sarathfrancis90).
  • Fixed mixing AST error on warnings (by @​MahinAnowar).

8.5.19

  • Fixed cleaning before for new nodes inserted to Root (by @​MahinAnowar).

8.5.18

  • Restricted loading previous source maps file to the opts.from folder for security reasons (use unsafeMap: true to disable the check).

8.5.17

  • Fixed Maximum call stack size exceeded error.
  • Fixed Prototype hijacking for postcss.fromJSON().
  • Fixed Input#origin() for unmapped end position (by @​chatman-media).

8.5.16

  • Fixed Input#origin() position (by @​mizdra).
  • Fixed raws after rehydrating a JSON AST (by @​sarathfrancis90).
  • Fixed putting parent-less node in nodes of new node (by @​MahinAnowar).
  • Fixed computing offset in positionBy() (by @​greymoth-jp).
  • Fixed rangeBy() on index: 0 (by @​sarathfrancis90).

Updates `undici` from 7.24.3 to 8.9.0
Release notes

Sourced from undici's releases.

v8.9.0

What's Changed

  • fix(decompress): preserve response trailers by @​Ram-blip in nodejs/undici#5572
  • build(deps-dev): bump ws from 8.21.0 to 8.21.1 by @​dependabot[bot] in nodejs/undici#5576
  • fix: validate coerced header values for CRLF by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5579
  • fix: handle frozen globalThis in setGlobalDispatcher by @​mhayk in nodejs/undici#5574
  • Ignore auto-generated .npmrc on Windows by @​tsctx in nodejs/undici#5583

New Contributors

  • @​mhayk made their first contribution in nodejs/undici#5574

Full Changelog: https://github.com/nodejs/undici/compare/v8.8.0...v8.9.0

v8.8.0

What's Changed

  • fetch: use ReadableStreamTee for cloning streams by @​KhafraDev in nodejs/undici#5517
  • fix(benchmarks): adjust got after v15 upgrade by @​slagiewka in nodejs/undici#5526
  • feat(mock): support asynchronous reply options callbacks by @​Develop-KIM in nodejs/undici#5534
  • docs: clarify proxy threat model by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5530
  • docs: clarify MockAgent pool usage by @​vibhor-aggr in nodejs/undici#5542
  • docs: clarify parser timeout precision by @​vibhor-aggr in nodejs/undici#5543
  • fix: handle flat alternating header arrays in cache normalizeHeaders by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5536
  • chore(benchmarks): require(esm) on ESM-only packages by @​slagiewka in nodejs/undici#5527
  • fix: run idle socket validation off setImmediate instead of setTimeout by @​carlotestor in nodejs/undici#5499
  • docs: add custom interceptor example by @​vibhor-aggr in nodejs/undici#5548
  • fix(h1): ignore type of service errors by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5547
  • fix(fetch): convert null init in Response.json by @​Ram-blip in nodejs/undici#5540
  • fix(redirect): remove body headers after POST-to-GET by @​Ram-blip in nodejs/undici#5551
  • build(deps-dev): bump fast-check from 4.8.0 to 4.9.0 by @​dependabot[bot] in nodejs/undici#5556
  • fix(h2): allow stream-bodied requests to multiplex on a busy session by @​GiHoon1123 in nodejs/undici#5538
  • fix(h2): destroy aborted stream synchronously instead of via setImmediate by @​staylor in nodejs/undici#5559
  • fix(decompress): skip HEAD responses by @​Ram-blip in nodejs/undici#5564
  • ci: build undici with node.js v26 by @​shivarm in nodejs/undici#5237
  • docs: clarify top-level request option url fields by @​vibhor-aggr in nodejs/undici#5545
  • test: add unexpected disconnect guards to http2 tests by @​Develop-KIM in nodejs/undici#5533
  • fix: track origins by client map key in Agent teardown by @​emmayusufu in nodejs/undici#5537
  • fix: enforce must-revalidate and proxy-revalidate over max-stale and stale-if-error by @​jeswr in nodejs/undici#5511
  • fix(retry): handle Retry-After zero delay by @​Ram-blip in nodejs/undici#5519
  • fix: honor stale-if-error on connection errors during revalidation by @​jeswr in nodejs/undici#5513
  • fix: store revalidation-only responses so etag revalidation can engage by @​jeswr in nodejs/undici#5515
  • fix(h2): prevent uncaughtException from onHttp2SocketError accessing undefined kClient by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5546
  • fix(h2): complete request stream on 'end' instead of waiting for 'close' by @​staylor in nodejs/undici#5560
  • fix: invalidate Location and Content-Location URIs on unsafe methods by @​jeswr in nodejs/undici#5514
  • test: deflake invalid websocket close status test by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5550
  • refactor: replace tspl with node:test t.plan in connect-timeout tests by @​mcollina in nodejs/undici#5518
  • fix(h2): release completed requests from queue by @​staylor in nodejs/undici#5569

New Contributors

  • @​Develop-KIM made their first contribution in nodejs/undici#5534
  • @​carlotestor made their first contribution in nodejs/undici#5499

  • 7d3cf92 fix: validate blob body content type

  • 4fe5bc5 fix: handle empty qualified private cache directive
  • 10d93fc fix: harden cookie domain, path, and unparsed attribute validation
  • a17e301 Ignore auto-generated .npmrc on Windows (#5583)
  • a0922b0 fix: handle frozen globalThis in setGlobalDispatcher (#5574)
